en.chat.title: Support team
en.chat.simulated: Simulated chat. Answers are scripted for this prototype.
en.chat.hello: Hi, this is the student support team. How can we help?
en.chat.a.book: Tap Counselling on the home screen, choose “Book a session”, then pick a day and a time. It takes less than a minute.
en.chat.a.office: The international office is in Building A, ground floor, Monday to Friday from 10:00 to 17:00. You can also book a video call.
en.chat.q.lang: Can I get help in Portuguese?
en.chat.a.lang: Yes. Each advisor lists the languages they speak. Most services offer Portuguese and English, and some offer French or Spanish.
en.chat.a.card: Go to IT and student card in the library, level 1. Bring an ID document. You can book a 15 minute slot.
en.chat.fallback: Thanks. In a real version, a member of the support team would reply here. For now, try the quick questions above.
